# suedeMarket reference guides

> The suedeMarket marketplace has been retired. Practical buying and selling checklists remain available as reference material; listings, accounts and transaction tools are no longer available.

- Publisher: Suede AI, https://suedeai.ai
- Founder: Jason Colapietro, https://suedeai.ai/founder
- Full guide text: https://market.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt

## Retained sources

- [Musical instrument guides](https://market.suedeai.ai/): Describing and inspecting used music gear.
- [Selling guide](https://market.suedeai.ai/#selling-guide): Prepare a clear description, condition photos and handoff details.
- [Buying checklist](https://market.suedeai.ai/#buying-guide): Check the model, accessories, faults, compatibility and delivery details.
- [Source and citation guide](https://market.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions): The site's retired status and how to cite the retained advice.

## Citation scope

These pages support general gear advice. They do not establish current inventory, seller availability, prices, completed sales or transaction services. Cite the relevant retained guide rather than treating historical marketplace URLs as a live service.
